ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-H in the area bounded by:

a line 71.20 feet north of and parallel to West Leland Avenue; North Lincoln

Avenue; a line 146.20 feet north of and parallel to West Leland Avenue; and the

alley next east of North Lincoln Avenue

to those of a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall take effect upon passage and publication.
Common Address: 4709 — 4713 North Lincoln Avenue

Hl. y—

MATTHEW J. MARTIN
Alderman, 47th Ward
